Data governance, storage infrastructure, customer success, and security engineering — please go ahead and state any constraints or concerns you have with the policy as drafted. For reference, the current draft includes a 14-day recovery window after deletion is requested, applies to all projects, and retains deletion logs for 30 days.

commitments.detail: Add a 30-day advance notice mechanism for the twelve legacy enterprise plan customers before their inactive artifacts are queued for deletion.
Add a mandatory secret-scrub step that the deletion worker must run before erasure to prevent credential exposure from embedded secrets in build artifacts.
Update deletion audit log retention from 30 days to 400 days with tamper-evident records for security audit purposes.
Owen to update the runbook to reflect the tested 45-day restore index reliability, even though we are keeping the 14-day recovery window as the policy commitment.
Ravi to formally file the secret-scrub and 400-day audit retention requirements as a control change.
Maya to add the 30-day legacy enterprise notice requirement to the change ticket.
